about: Canonical test corpus for TUNNEL-SPEC server profiles. Every edition's test suite reads this file (the FILTER-SPEC shared-asset pattern). An edition that disagrees with the corpus is wrong.
example_keys_note: ALL keys in this file are EXAMPLE keys generated for tests (marked EXAMPLE where free text allows). They are not real key material, protect nothing, and must never be replaced with real keys.
